asset.description: the plant/equipment the session related to, when the source supplies it

external_id.description: the source record's own identifier, as text

occurred_at.description: when the session/submission occurred - the sole temporal anchor

session.description: the session the worker attended, when the source supplies a stable session identifier

session_label.description: the tenant's own name for the training session (the Assignar form title, e.g. a Verification of Competency form)

worker.description: the worker whose attendance/completion the record is
